verdict.line: You lose if you let Jayce freely combo Hammer-stance Q into E before level 7 while you're pushed into his poke range; you win if you play around his stance swaps, deny the solo kill, and let Statikk Shiv plus Liandry's poison take over from level 13 on, where the 52.1% head-to-head over 1764 games tilts your way.

brief.thesis: Jayce is two champions stapled together: Cannon stance is a 600-range poke bot with Shock Blast (Q), Hammer stance is a dash-knockback brawler with To the Skies! (Q) into Thundering Blow (E). Every trade in this lane is decided by which stance he's in when he commits, and Teemo's entire plan is to punish the Hammer-stance engage with Blinding Dart (Q) while refusing to stand in Cannon-stance poke range. Early levels favor his longer effective threat range and solo-kill setups; once you hit your item spikes, stacked Toxic Shot (E) and Liandry's burn out-damage his bruiser build in extended fights.

theirWindow.when: Jayce swaps into Hammer stance near you
theirWindow.what: He's loading To the Skies! (Q, 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown) to dash in and follow with Thundering Blow (E) for a knockback trade, and his ultimate can empower that first hit from level 6. Hold Blinding Dart (Q) until he commits the dash — landing it blinds the follow-up autos and lets you walk out before E's knockback resets the exchange in his favor.

yourWindow.when: his Hammer-stance Q is on visible cooldown
yourWindow.what: With To the Skies! down he has no gap closer for up to 16 seconds early, only Cannon-stance poke. Walk up, stack Toxic Shot (E) autos, and shove the wave — he can't punish you for holding lane presence until that cooldown resets.

start.why: The highest-pick start (73.8% of games, 51.6% win rate) — the mana pool keeps you spamming Blinding Dart and poking with E autos instead of running dry against his sustained poke.

boots.why: 51.4% win rate over 755 games — the magic pen pushes Toxic Shot and Liandry's burn through whatever armor Jayce builds as a bruiser.

core.why: The highest-pick core path (41.6%, 56.8% win rate) — the proc gives you wave clear and movement speed to reset spacing after a Hammer-stance trade.
Max-HP burn stacks with Toxic Shot's damage-over-time to out-damage Jayce's HP-stacking bruiser build in anything past a short trade.
Lowers Noxious Trap's cooldown and adds magic pen, letting you flood river and tri-brush with mushrooms for vision denial and execute threshold on poisoned targets.

runes.keystoneWhy: The highest-pick page (35.5%, 53.5% win rate) — it rewards landing consecutive Toxic Shot autos to shred Jayce's lower early armor before he scales into a bruiser.

summoners.why: The dominant pick (88.6% of games, 51.1% win rate) — Ignite punishes Jayce if he overextends a Cannon-stance poke, and Flash is mandatory to get out of Thundering Blow's knockback follow-up before he resets the trade.

playing.title: Track the stance icon
playing.detail: Watch Jayce's weapon-stance indicator below his health bar. Hammer stance means dash-and-knockback threat; Cannon stance means ranged poke only — your spacing plan flips depending on which one he's in.

playing.title: Trade only in Cannon stance
playing.detail: When he's stuck in Cannon stance, stand at your own E range and auto him freely. Never stand inside 600 range when he's loaded for a Shock Blast poke.

playing.title: Blind the all-in, not the poke
playing.detail: Save Blinding Dart (Q, 8s cooldown) for the moment he commits To the Skies! (Hammer Q) at you. It blinds his follow-up autos so you can walk out of Thundering Blow's knockback range.

playing.title: Respect the level 3 and 6 spikes
playing.detail: His combo threat jumps once Thundering Blow ranks up and again at 6 when his ultimate empowers his first hit. Play passive and ward for ganks rather than contest trades on those levels.

playing.title: Seed mushrooms for vision denial
playing.detail: Once Noxious Trap (R) is up, drop mushrooms in river and tri-brush entrances. He has no reliable way to clear them from range, so they deny his ganks and roams for free.

playing.title: Itemize into his HP stacking
playing.detail: Jayce's bruiser build adds health, so Liandry's Torment's max-HP burn plus stacked Toxic Shot ticks let you out-trade him in extended skirmishes even though he wins the first burst exchange.

playing.title: Use W to reset spacing after trades
playing.detail: Pop Move Quick (W) after any exchange to kite back outside his dash and poke range before To the Skies! comes off cooldown, letting you disengage without burning Flash.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, and summoner spells above come from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reading — stance tracking, trade windows, and mushroom usage — is my own analysis.
